name: number-flow
title: Number Flow
description: An animated number: digits roll, signs and symbols fade and the width eases when the value changes, formatted with Intl.NumberFormat, as a React wrapper over NumberFlow.
author: Maxwell Barvian <https://github.com/barvian>
docs:
Installed `NumberFlow`, `NumberFlowGroup`, `continuous` and `useCanAnimate` (`@/components/ui/number-flow`), a thin React wrapper over [NumberFlow](https://github.com/barvian/number-flow) 0.6.2 (`@number-flow/react`). Its props, defaults and look are NumberFlow's; `announce` is the one addition.

```tsx
import { NumberFlow, NumberFlowGroup, continuous } from "@/components/ui/number-flow";

<NumberFlowGroup>
  <NumberFlow value={price} format={{ style: "currency", currency: "USD" }} />
  <NumberFlow value={change} format={{ style: "percent", signDisplay: "always" }} />
</NumberFlowGroup>

<NumberFlow value={count} plugins={[continuous]} announce />
```

It renders a `<number-flow-react>` custom element with a shadow root (declarative on the server, so the number shows before hydration). Style it like text: color, font and size inherit; `tabular-nums` keeps digits from shifting; `line-height` spaces the digits during a spin. Parts can be styled with `::part()`: `left`, `right`, `number`, `integer`, `fraction`, `digit`, `integer-digit`, `fraction-digit`, `symbol`, and each symbol's type (`currency`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `plusSign`, `minusSign`, `percentSign`, `group`, `decimal`). The `--number-flow-mask-height` (0.25em) and `--number-flow-mask-width` (0.5em) tokens size the fade at the edges; NumberFlow also pads the number by the mask height.

Numbers in a numbering system other than latn (the default digits of ar-EG, fa-IR and similar locales) are shown as plain, correctly ordered text rather than animated: NumberFlow draws only the digits 0 to 9, and the other digits rendered blank when measured. Set `numberingSystem: "latn"` in `format` to animate them.

Under a strict Content Security Policy pass `nonce`, or allow its inline styles. Wraps NumberFlow by Maxwell Barvian (MIT); the license notice is at the end of the file.
